name: foldwing
description: Foldwing — draw one line, its mirror has to survive too.

scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "id=$SIM" -derivedDataPath .build/ios CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build >/dev/null && xcrun simctl install "$SIM" .build/ios/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/App.app && xcrun simctl terminate "$SIM" com.noqyris.foldwing 2>/dev/null; xcrun simctl launch "$SIM" com.noqyris.foldwing
